claim.statement: Over C, for every polynomial psi, let B=C[x,y,z,u]/(xy-z(z+1)), tpsi=u^2+psi(x), spsi=y-x*tpsi, Jpsi=(tpsi-spsi^2,z-spsi*x). Every nonzero C-linear LND E of B satisfies Jpsi intersect ker(E)=0. The quotient is C[X,R,V]/(RV-psi(X)), and no nonzero LND preserves Jpsi.
hypotheses: Base field is the complex numbers
psi is any polynomial, including the zero polynomial and repeated-root polynomials
E is a nonzero complex-linear locally nilpotent derivation of the exact ring B
not_assumed: the surface quotient is a domain
claim.action_conclusion: No nontrivial algebraic additive-group action on Spec(B) preserves the whole closed subscheme defined by Jpsi

verdict_scope: The strongest mathematical prose theorem is supported by a checked deduction from the stated cores and unconditional lift. Direct formal encoding of the arbitrary family is only partial.

components.reason: The explicit two inverse quotient maps recover all generators. The quadric maps to -X^2*(S^2-U^2-psi(X)), but no cancellation of X is used. R=S-U, V=S+U has a polynomial inverse using 1/2.

All substitution maps and LND deductions work at psi=0 and repeated roots. For psi nonzero the surface relation is primitive irreducible linear in V; for psi=0, (RV)=(R) intersect (V), so the whole quotient is reduced but reducible.
Theorem 1 at t=u^2+psi(ab) gives Jpsi*C=(vpsi). In Wpsi=a^2*psi(ab), the monomial a^(n+2)*b^n has auxiliary degree -n<=0, including the constant and zero cases.

Use the unconditional exists_weight_preserving_lnd_lift, not the I-specific lift_invariant. Injectivity keeps the lifted derivation and h nonzero. The factorization iota(h)=vpsi*q has both factors nonzero in the fixed characteristic-zero domain C, where factorial closure applies.

Lower-perturbation rigidity contradicts any such nonzero lifted invariant. The restriction kernel is exactly Jpsi intersect ker(E); the corresponding morphism to Spec(ker(E)) is dominant without a finite-generation assumption.

gpsi is nonzero since it evaluates to -1 at the actual B-point (0,0,-1,0). If E(Jpsi) is contained in Jpsi, the last nonzero iterate of gpsi is a nonzero invariant in Jpsi. The characteristic-zero action/LND dictionary gives the action statement.

The two general algebraic cores and unconditional lift are encoded, but no one of the eight printed declarations quantifies over psi or asserts the family quotient, invariant restriction, or nonstabilization.
Source comparison establishes a precise scope extension relative to the inspected October statements, not global novelty.
